integrity: A symbolic proof with enumerated finite base identities and standalone reproducibility code; no external independent audit or certification performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the stated balanced binary four-uniform family; this does not settle eventual periodicity for arbitrary Parikh-constant morphisms. An unindexed equivalent earlier case classification remains possible. Finite checker tests supplement, not replace, the induction.
title: Complete abelian-complexity classification of balanced binary four-uniform substitutions
